title: Baby Resting in Stroller Outdoors, 1950s Deckle Edge Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot showing an infant lying back amidst soft blankets inside a pram or stroller outdoors on a sunny day. In the upper background, another small child stands along the pavement. The photo features a classic white border with deckled edges, representative of family keepsakes and amateur photography of the post-war era.
